# Description

## Business context / goal

When the company pays Wellcare Advanced Clinic for a maid's treatment, that cost is meant to be added to her outstanding balance as a loan and recovered. If the loan is never raised, the company has paid for treatment and written it off without deciding to.

This check reconciles clinic payments against the maid's loan record and opens a case where the cost was never added.

**Expected outcome:** money paid to the clinic for a maid's treatment and never added to her balance as a loan is surfaced, instead of being silently absorbed.

No AI verifier on this check (`AI verifier: Not required` — the finding is a reconciliation, not a judgement about what someone wrote).

## Trigger & schedule

**Scheduled.** Monthly, on the 15th at 06:00 Asia/Dubai. Each run audits the *previous full calendar month* — payments need time to settle, so the two-week lag is deliberate.

No webhook, no manual trigger, no inbound endpoint of any kind.

The conversion is **already applied** — it was the smallest of the batch. `Run Monthly` schedule trigger present, workflow timezone `Asia/Dubai`, no callbacks and none needed. See `records/webhook-to-schedule-conversion.md`.

## Inputs & data sources

ERP production only (`erpbackendpro.maids.cc`). **Read-only — the flow writes nothing back to ERP.** 5 endpoints across 37 nodes:

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | /accounting/transactions/page/advancesearchNew | Find the clinic payment population |
| GET | /accounting/transactions/{id} | Per-transaction detail |
| GET | /accounting/transactions/file/{id} | Download the attached data file for a transaction |
| POST | /payroll/HousemaidPayroll/filterHousemaids | Resolve the maid from the payment (2 nodes: primary + fallback) |
| GET | /payroll/loans/getHousemaidLoans/{housemaidId} | The maid's loan record — the other half of the reconciliation |

No Snowflake. One ERP-hosted file download.

### Known route exceptions

Two endpoints are on the 2026-08-25 dead-end route ban:

- `/accounting/transactions/page/advancesearchNew` — on the 2026-08-25 dead-end route ban. Previously disclosed here as **Section A, no alternative**; that is **no longer true**, so the ERP-team dependency is **withdrawn**. The legacy `POST /accounting/transactions/page/advancesearch` accepts a bounded id list — `[{"property":"id","operation":"in","value":[...]}]` — and returns exactly those rows, 120 verified in a single call on 2026-08-30. That is the targeted accessor whose absence made the original route a dead end. Rewiring to it is recommended but is **not** a blocker for this deployment: the flow runs correctly as it stands.
- `/payroll/HousemaidPayroll/filterHousemaids` — paginated. ⚠ Note the ERP Variables entry for this route: *omitting the `maidPayrollTypes` filter returns EVERY maid ever* (121,216 live at 2026-08-19). Confirm the filter is always sent explicitly and can never fall through to empty.

Both disclosed here rather than omitted. ERP-team dependency.
